beatAssist: Bar alignment with a known tempo
beatAssistHelp: Enter a verified BPM and an audible downbeat. The selection includes overlap before that beat, so crossfade does not shorten the intended bar cycle. This does not detect tempo, repair rhythm, or ensure matching harmony and phrasing. Listen before approving.
invalidBeatGrid: Allow room for the overlap before the downbeat and all selected bars after it. Check tempo, duration and source boundaries.
beatGridApplied: Selection aligned to {{bars}} bars at {{bpm}} BPM; overlap compensated. Musical continuity still requires listening.
selectionLimit: Choose up to 200 candidates per operation. Clear the selection or remove candidates to continue.
listenToSeam: Listen across the join at {{at}} seconds
tagFilterHelp: Match every selected tag together with text, session, favorites and version type. Filters are remembered for this project.
noTags: No tags in this project yet. Select candidates to add organizational tags.
tagRules: 1–48 characters per tag, up to 32 per audio. Case, repeated whitespace and equivalent Unicode forms are normalized. Audio is unchanged.
filtersSaveFailed: Filters are active for this session but could not be saved. Try changing them again.
noMatchesHelp: Clear or adjust the filters to see the project's other audio. Your files and comparison selection are preserved.
regionHelp: Choose an excerpt, listen in the existing player and confirm a new WAV. The source stays intact. Repeating an identical selection reuses its registered region.
styleExplanation: Style guides ACE-Step through reference_id. It does not become cover or audio2audio source content.
sourceExplanation: Source content is used only by an explicit cover/audio2audio request. Its requested duration must match this excerpt.
regionDurationLimits: Allowed excerpt: {{minimum}}–120 seconds. Mono/stereo, 8–192 kHz; the original sample rate is preserved.
styleUnsupported: Stable Audio has no style-reference contract. Choose ACE-Step or explicitly select Source content.
invalidRegion: Choose a non-empty region inside the source and within the selected engine's duration and channel limits.
regionRights: You are responsible for permission to use this recording. Confirming an excerpt does not grant rights or authorize generation.
regionSaved: Region confirmed; source preserved. No generation was started.
regionReady: Region available in the catalog and MCP:
